newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns AA+ rating to TEPCO straight bond.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns AA+ rating to TEPCO straight bond.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp (S&P) said on Tuesday it had assigned its AA+ rating to Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc's (TEPCO) 100 billion yen 2.625 percent straight bond series 439 due July 31, 2007.
The rating outlook is stable, it said.

The rating reflects the monopoly TEPCO enjoys as provider of electricity to Japan's Kanto region, centred on Tokyo, and its acceptable level of financial risk for the rating category, S&P said in a statement.

The company benefits from financing advantages and other support from its regulator, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry, as well as from close cooperation with other electric power companies, it said.
